_comment: AXEM-SX Distribution — maps every OBS package to its ISO tier

pro.notes: KDE panel replaces axem-panel. axem-sx-dock included. axem-panel via soft-depot only.

gold.description: ISO3 — GNOME 48 / Wayland + AXEM dark + gold identity
gold.notes: Pure GNOME Shell UX. No axem-panel, no axem-sx-dock. axem-control-hub + soft-depot + axem-console only.

meta_packages._comment: v1.0.1 user-facing wrapper packages. ISO stays slim; users opt into the full curated experience via one zypper command.

axem-sx-repos.role: Ships /etc/zypp/repos.d/axem-sx.repo (enabled) + packman.repo (disabled). Required by every pattern so the installed system can resolve axem-sx-* packages out of the box.

axem-sx-codecs.role: Multimedia readiness — pulls gstreamer-{good,bad,ugly,libav}, ffmpeg-7, vlc. Ships /usr/bin/axem-sx-codecs-upgrade-to-packman for optional Packman vendor-swap.

axem-sx-apps-common.role: Curated cross-edition app set: LibreOffice, VLC, Inkscape, kcalc, Spectacle, KolourPaint, Flatpak, git/curl/wget/tar/xz/gzip/unzip/7zip/micro-editor.

axem-sx-thirdparty-helper.role: axem-sx-install-thirdparty whiptail menu — guided install of Spotify/Discord/VS Code (Flathub) + Anti-Gravity (OBS).

axem-sx-pro-full.role: One-command Pro: patterns-axem-sx-pro + repos + codecs + apps-common + thirdparty-helper + discover6-backend-flatpak.

axem-sx-light-full.role: One-command Light: patterns-axem-sx-light + repos + codecs + apps-common + thirdparty-helper.

axem-sx-gold-full.role: One-command Gold: patterns-axem-sx-gold + repos + codecs + apps-common + thirdparty-helper + flatpak-remote-flathub.
